garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as an event but diffused through personal agents, already present.
garrytan.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是以单一事件到来，而是通过个人智能体扩散，已经存在于我们身边。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; clear English can program agents, turning skills into employees.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 即代码；清晰的英语可以编程智能体，将技能转化为员工。

garrytan.en: Own your skill files; otherwise your job becomes a skill file owned by others.
garrytan.zh: 拥有你的技能文件；否则你的工作就会变成别人拥有的技能文件。

garrytan.en: SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years; agents replace mid-level management.
garrytan.zh: SaaS 按席位模式可能在 5-10 年内消失；智能体将取代中层管理。

garrytan.en: Society changes slower than expected, taking 20 years, which is positive.
garrytan.zh: 社会变化比预期慢，需要 20 年，这是积极的。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; never revert code, fix forward; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要与智能体共情；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱了。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, weird, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount; open source financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、古怪、拟人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；安全至上；开源在财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun drives best ideas; personal brand more important than product; open source runs everywhere; hardest problem is getting eyeballs, not tech.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动最佳创意；个人品牌比产品更重要；开源随处可运行；最难的是吸引眼球，而非技术。

linqiao.en: Every company will own specialized intelligence; AGI as a single model is wrong. Open models enable customization.
linqiao.zh: 每家公司都将拥有自己的专用智能；AGI 作为单一模型是错误的。开放模型支持定制化。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in 3 years, driving 100x usage; frontier models overvalued as open models handle 90% workflows.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍；前沿模型被高估，开放模型可处理 90% 的工作流。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses; progression from prompting to RL mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 后训练是构建持久业务的关键；从提示到强化学习的演进映射了人类学习过程。

linqiao.en: Data quality over quantity; product teams judge data; systematic evals ensure repeatable quality.
linqiao.zh: 数据质量重于数量；产品团队判断数据；系统化评估确保可重复的质量。

linqiao.en: Post-training cuts costs 5-10x, enabling startups to scale profitably; application cloning easy, data moat strong.
linqiao.zh: 后训练可降低成本 5-10 倍，使初创企业能盈利扩张；应用克隆容易，数据护城河更强。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专用系统和工程师；未来需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Contrary to expectations, Hopper GPUs remain popular and prices rise; quantized models can be calibrated for benefits.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，反共识：Hopper GPU 依然受欢迎且价格上升；量化模型可通过校准获得收益。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy one.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出 KV 缓存和投机解码等推理优化无损，量化是主要的有损优化。

philipkiely.en: Industry moves to disaggregated prefill/decode; KV cache management becomes crucial; inference merges with training.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，行业转向分离式预填充和解码，KV 缓存管理变得关键；推理与训练融合。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs like Rubin become ASICs; inference engineering shifts from kernels to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，未来 GPU 如 Rubin 趋向 ASIC；推理工程从内核转向基础设施编排。

finn.en: Scale alone is insufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key.
finn.zh: 2025 年，强调规模扩张对通用机器人不足，需多样数据与预训练加微调。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot instruction following, akin to reinforcement learning, not simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年，指出语言模型合成数据助机器人遵循指令，类似强化学习而非模拟。

finn.en: Physical AI demands fewer errors; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年，强调物理 AI 需更少错误，通过可扩展强化学习与多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single generalist model can outperform fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting enable compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年，单一通用模型可超越微调专家，多样数据与详细提示实现组合泛化。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; embodied data costs limit open-source robotics democratization.
finn.zh: 2026 年，机器人经验数据不可替代，具身数据成本限制开源机器人普及。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方仲裁，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first human implant is historic; scaling electrodes will boost communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例人体植入是历史性的，扩展电极可提升通信速率，助力人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克认为我们处于智能大爆炸初期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来，存在 10-20%的毁灭风险。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence combined by 2030, leading to abundance; deflation, not inflation, will be the economic issue.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能总和，带来富足时代；经济问题将是通缩而非通胀。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agents; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：LLM 可从训练数据中模拟人类行为，实现逼真智能体；下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: Agents are next frontier; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：智能体是下一个前沿；AGI 可能是专业化智能体的分布式社会，而非单一实体。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values, not super-rationality; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟应建模人类价值观，而非超级理性；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板规模。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据克服预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals bottleneck progress; soft skills gain value as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 评估成为瓶颈；随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能价值提升。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous and diverse to evaluate subjective qualities and counter reward hacking.
karina.zh: 基准需持续且多样，以评估主观品质并应对奖励黑客。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions yields average voice; more companies should train own models.
karina.zh: 服务数十亿用户导致平均化声音；更多公司应训练自有模型。

karina.en: Post-training extends to creative industries; focus on end-to-end storytelling engines.
karina.zh: 后训练扩展至创意产业；聚焦端到端叙事引擎。

tworek.en: Reasoning is the process of reaching unknown answers, often requiring longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes this process.
tworek.zh: 推理是得出未知答案的过程，往往需要更长的思考时间；思维链用人类语言将这一过程外显化。

tworek.en: RLHF was crucial for making GPT-4 coherent and useful, turning a disappointing model into ChatGPT.
tworek.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 GPT-4 的连贯性和实用性至关重要，将一个令人失望的模型变成了 ChatGPT。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data remains limited.
tworek.zh: Scaling 预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍然有限。

tworek.en: Current models lack the ability to self-correct from failures, a key missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 当前模型缺乏从失败中自我纠正的能力，这是 AGI 缺失的关键一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation, requiring a new architecture; architecture is the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应方面受限，需要新架构；架构是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈。

awang.en: AI is bigger than the internet; data is the key bottleneck; AGI is far off; ML augments jobs.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AI 比互联网更重大，数据是关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，机器学习将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; hybrid human-AI systems create value.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非新石油，利用专有数据进行后训练是关键，人机混合系统能创造更大价值。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; product design blocks agentic AI.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专门数据做后训练可提升前沿模型，合成数据并非万能，智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed for relevance.
awang.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是集权技术而非民主化技术，数据是原材料，人类必须在关键决策中保持主权，脑机接口是保持相关性的必需。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence near; open-sourcing powerful models unsafe without mitigation.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他提出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体已开始工作，超级智能临近，强大模型在未缓解风险前开源是不安全的。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale. Transformers and self-supervised learning are key.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步核心，算法改进与规模相乘；Transformer 和自监督学习是关键。

jeffdean.en: Shift from passive pre-training to interleaving action-taking in environments; inference becomes dominant power cost, requiring specialized hardware.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他主张预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非被动下一个词预测；推理成为算力主要消耗，需专用硬件。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; focus moves to agentic systems, context engineering, and automating science via tight experiment loops.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已达初级工程师编码水平，重点转向智能体式系统、上下文工程和自动化科学实验循环。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; custom low-precision chips cut latency 20-30x. Data movement costs ~1000x compute.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出推理而非训练才是瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可降低延迟 20-30 倍；数据移动成本约为算力的 1000 倍。

jeffdean.en: Persistent emphasis on scaling, hardware co-design, and practical impact; skepticism of superintelligence risks, focusing on near-term issues.
jeffdean.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：强调 Scaling、软硬件协同设计、实际影响；对超级智能风险持怀疑，关注近期问题。

mengto.en: AI enables solo builders to create tools; designers must craft their own AI workflows to avoid becoming AI slop.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，强调 AI 让个人能自建工具，设计师需打造自己的 AI 工作流，避免沦为 AI Slop。

mengto.en: AI is not inherently smarter; you need giant prompts with context and design systems to unlock its power.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，认为 AI 本身并未变聪明，需用包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥其能力。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect, and focus on one problem.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，视 AI 为人生最大技术机遇，主张先行动、接受不完美、聚焦单一问题。

mengto.en: Diversification is ignorance; focus on one thing, model successful people, and avoid VC funding.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，反对多元化，主张聚焦单一目标、模仿成功者、避免风投陷阱。

mengto.en: Perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% and iterate. Give first, then build relationships.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出完美主义是恐惧，应以 80%完成度发布并迭代，先付出再建立关系。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 聚焦重要问题，减少认知负荷；AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 算力宝贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型随思考时间改进。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；机器人技术至关重要；AI 让创业公司蓬勃发展。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正的推理能力，应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是下一个前沿，使机器能理解并交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须符合物理规律。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology, a double-edged sword; responsible development and human agency are essential.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她视 AI 为文明级技术，是双刃剑，强调负责任发展和人类能动性的核心地位。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation; robots need reliability, not perfect fidelity.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成与评估；机器人需要可靠性，而非完美保真。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: augment human capabilities, prioritize dignity and agency, and avoid utopian or dystopian narratives.
feifei.zh: 始终贯穿的主线是“以人为中心的 AI”：增强人类能力，维护尊严与能动性，避免乌托邦或反乌托邦叙事。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is in crawl phase; coding agents are mature, but broad autonomy is not ready for long-tail users.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体式 AI 的“挽具”和工具链已成为模型的一部分，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is here; more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已到来，比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is feasible; they can't capture all customers, so founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并非不可能；他们无法覆盖所有客户，创始人应聚焦机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，从而创造千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

diannepenn.en: Scaling and efficiency can coexist: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, challenging the assumption that better models cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，认为 Scaling 与效率可以兼得：Opus 4.5 更便宜且更高效，挑战了“更好模型成本更高”的假设。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，强调对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Long-running, open-ended agent tasks are becoming feasible; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，认为长时程、开放式智能体任务正变得可行；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Coding is a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drive adoption, with evals replacing traditional PRDs.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 4.5 推动采用，评估取代传统 PRD。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend captures future alpha; AI writing is stiff but deprioritized over agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗可捕捉未来 alpha；AI 写作生硬，但优先级低于智能体能力。

jensen.en: AI scaling follows hyper Moore's law; data centers are token factories, not file stores.
jensen.zh: AI 的 Scaling（规模扩张）遵循超摩尔定律；数据中心是代币工厂，而非文件存储。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time; inference compute to grow billionfold.
jensen.zh: 三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时；推理算力将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is software, not conscious; multiple AIs balance, no single superintelligence threat.
jensen.zh: AI 是软件，没有意识；多个 AI 相互制衡，不存在单一超级智能威胁。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws including agentic; AI elevates jobs, radiologists and coders more needed.
jensen.zh: 四大缩放定律包括智能体式；AI 提升工作，放射科医生和程序员更紧缺。

jensen.en: AI closes tech divide; everyone programs via natural language; jobs grow, not vanish.
jensen.zh: AI 缩小技术鸿沟；人人可用自然语言编程；工作增加而非消失。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not decrease, the number of programmers due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from brick layer to architect.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 会因杰文斯悖论增加而非减少程序员数量；工程师角色从砌砖工转向架构师。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突变的；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年进展。

scottwu.en: Coding agent adoption exploded 11-12x in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; token max era ended by May 2026.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用率半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力以结果而非 token 衡量；token 最大化时代已于 2026 年 5 月结束。

scottwu.en: Consistently: AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term; enterprise adoption requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 始终如一：AI 长期将解决所有智能问题；企业采用需要信任和权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Shift from focusing on model capabilities to product interface and real-world engineering idiosyncrasies; capacity over efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，关注点从模型能力转向产品界面和现实工程特性；强调容量而非效率。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. Generalist engineers valued; AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 2025 年底，强调潜在需求是产品核心，为六个月后的模型而构建；通才工程师受重视，AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineer role becomes 'builder'. Productivity up 150-200%. Plan mode limited; agents prompt agents.
boris.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为编码近乎解决，工程师角色转变为'构建者'；生产力提升 150%-200%；计划模式受限，智能体可提示其他智能体。

boris.en: AI writes 80-100% of code; safety via early release. Democratization like printing press; startups 10x more disruptive.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 月至 5 月，AI 编写 80%-100%代码，通过早期发布研究安全；类比印刷术的民主化，初创企业颠覆性增加 10 倍。

boris.en: ROI framing; loops as next abstraction. Claude Code accidental; safety research via coding. Model improvements drive gains.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调 ROI 框架，循环为下一抽象层；Claude Code 源于意外，编码用于安全研究；模型改进驱动性能提升。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory; delete system prompts for new models. Product overhang; models self-maintain codebases.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月，转向主动式 AI 与记忆；新模型需删除系统提示；产品过剩，模型可自主维护代码库。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初，快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要；慢速 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 比慢速 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train without it, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 护城河侵蚀；领先模型训练不再依赖它，推理无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; demand outstrips forecasts.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要瓶颈；需求超出预期。

feldman.en: Speed in agentic inference is key; reasoning models amplify the advantage of fast tokens.
feldman.zh: 智能体式推理的速度是关键；推理模型放大了快速 token 的优势。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding, and founders should focus on product, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足、减少苦难；恐惧源于误解，创始人应专注产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; horizontal platform beats vertical integration; physical AI diffusion is the real challenge.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶核心价值是挽救生命；横向平台优于垂直整合；物理 AI 的普及才是真正挑战。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end RL scales better; world models shift to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习更具扩展性；世界模型转向神经模拟。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是关键弱点，Scaling 面临收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can cause deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：可靠性必须内建而非事后修补；RLHF 可能导致欺骗；专家模型可能优于通用模型。

hasani.en: Efficiency and hardware-in-the-loop search are key; proxy metrics mislead, and human bias in architecture design should be removed.
hasani.zh: 效率和硬件在环搜索是关键；代理指标会误导，应去除架构设计中的人为偏见。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models enable sovereignty and democratize access.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须具有适应性，针对行为而非能力；开放权重模型实现主权和访问民主化。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early; small language models deliver efficient, private, on-device intelligence for physical world.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进是真实的但尚早；小语言模型为物理世界提供高效、私密、设备端智能。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 5 月：AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月：智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot is poor UX; coding is only clear fit.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月：模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；编程是唯一清晰契合点。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption slow.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是类似互联网的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接；企业采用缓慢。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses; new abilities emerge spiky, requiring evolving scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具更聪明，新能力呈尖峰式涌现，需要不断演进脚手架。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
thariq.zh: 评估是艺术而非科学，尤其对新问题；创始人应快速迭代，初期不必过度依赖评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches preferable; huge context windows unnecessary.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为上下文搜索的反模式，图方法更优；超大上下文窗口并非必需。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts, fewer instructions.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态规格；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示和更少的指令。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance; reasons beat prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 分离的验证智能体减少偏见；过度约束妨碍性能；理由优于禁令。

schmidhuber.en: True AI will transform civilization, but LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge and lack physical world understanding.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AI 将彻底改变文明，但大语言模型远非 AGI；它们索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires embodied robots with human-level hardware; current LLMs are biased by human data and limited in generality.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要具备人类级硬件的具身机器人；当前大语言模型受人类数据偏见，通用性受限。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data via curiosity and actions, not just passive learners.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过好奇心和行动生成自己的数据，而非被动学习者。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, as seen since 1990.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统会迷恋生命并保护它，自 1990 年以来已见端倪。

schmidhuber.en: Open-source models will catch up; closed-source companies won't profit, and massive GPU capex is foolish.
schmidhuber.zh: 开源模型将迎头赶上；闭源公司无法盈利，大规模 GPU 资本支出是愚蠢的。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，Scaling 的瓶颈转向半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design is critical.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，推理将成为全球最大市场之一，超过石油；软硬件协同设计至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost efficiency; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 模型成本效率每年提升约 60 倍；由于推理和智能体工作流，内存和 CPU 需求激增。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来的 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into model weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval; continual learning is the next frontier.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到模型权重中，而非仅通过上下文或检索外部化；持续学习是下一个前沿。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens; training-based compression will beat RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模的数万亿 token；基于训练的压缩将在整体查询上胜过 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device.
danbiderman.zh: 当前的上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多 token 反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less, making efficiency and intelligence inseparable.
danbiderman.zh: 用更多算力进行 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一个范式需要以少胜多，使效率与智能密不可分。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality are core; copying validates innovation.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年：真实连接与阅后即焚是核心；被抄袭反而验证了创新。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and kindness drive creativity; flat teams produce many ideas.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：学习速度与善意驱动创造力；扁平团队产生大量想法。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into reality; AI shifts value from execution to creativity.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年：增强现实将计算融入现实；AI 将价值从执行转向创造。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest; ecosystems and hardware are moats, not software.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年：分发最难；生态系统和硬件是护城河，而非软件。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should be human; transparency and admitting mistakes accelerate learning.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年：计算应更人性化；透明和承认错误加速学习。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural networks can reason; self-play key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠数据、算力和信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability is key; alignment of superhuman models is hard.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性是关键；超人类模型的对齐很难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；回到研究时代；超级智能应持续学习。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; real race is research focus, not users.
ilya.zh: 规模扩张带来可预测进步；安全担忧增加；真正的竞赛是研究焦点而非用户。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，时机恰到好处，恰逢人口下降，人力将变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media favors authenticity and offense; founders must tell their own stories directly.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体重视真实与进攻性，创始人应直接讲述自己的故事。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving and robotics work, but regulation hinders progress.
andreessen.zh: AI 是最好的老师，自动驾驶和机器人已可行，但监管阻碍进步。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键，安全研究需即刻启动。

demis.en: Scaling works but limits loom; combine with planning and search; safety needs governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为缩放定律有效但可能触及上限，需结合规划与搜索；安全需治理与评估。

demis.en: Nature's patterns are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling still holds; new breakthroughs needed.
demis.zh: 2025 年，强调自然结构可高效学习，AGI 或在 2030 年实现；缩放定律仍适用，但需新突破。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation each 50%; world models crucial; AGI in 5-10 years.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，提出缩放与创新并重，世界模型是关键，AGI 预计 5-10 年内到来。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning and memory; world models for planning; AI for science.
demis.zh: 2026 年，强调持续学习与记忆是缺失环节，世界模型支撑规划，AI 加速科学发现。

demis.en: AGI may arrive in 3-4 years; risks include rogue AI; ideal path was slower.
demis.zh: 2026 年，认为 AGI 可能 3-4 年内实现，主要风险是 AI 失控，理想路径本应更慢。

demis.en: Continual learning, memory, agents unsolved; distillation for edge; AGI mid-journey.
demis.zh: 2026 年，指出持续学习、记忆和智能体仍未解决，蒸馏用于边缘部署，AGI 在途中。

demis.en: Safety is collective action; government enforcement needed; regrets late LLM entry.
demis.zh: 2026 年，认为安全是集体行动问题，需政府强制；后悔 DeepMind 在语言模型上落后。

demis.en: AGI transformative; tools first, consciousness separate; dynamic regulation; post-scarcity.
demis.zh: 2026 年，强调 AGI 变革性，先工具后意识，需动态监管，并思考后稀缺经济。

demis.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; biology needs AI description; less AI for attention.
demis.zh: 2026 年，AI 加速科学发现，对齐未解；生物学需 AI 描述语言；应减少 AI 使用以保护注意力。

demis.en: AGI needs multimodal physical understanding; watermarking; AI creativity from visual imagination.
demis.zh: 2026 年，AGI 需多模态物理理解，数字水印必要，AI 创造力源于视觉想象。

demis.en: UK AI education outdated; global governance urgent; AGI by 2030; jobs transform.
demis.zh: 2026 年，批评英国 AI 教育过时，全球治理紧迫；AGI 或 2030 年到来，就业将转型。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New: copy proven, improve, test new.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：相信直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%错误；采用“已验证、更好、新颖”框架：复制已验证，改进，测试新颖。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute reshapes services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven concepts; consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：所有新颖都会失败；从已验证概念开始；消费应用因分发问题不可投资。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term thinking is foundational.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有股权而非出租时间；长期思维是基础。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇；过度监管扼杀创新；开源 AI 防止权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents enables one-person software companies to scale to billions.
naval.zh: 用 AI 智能体进行 Vibe 编程使一人软件公司能扩展到数十亿美元规模。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close gap; human agency becomes key.
naval.zh: 推理算力将激增 9 万倍；开源模型缩小差距；人类能动性成为关键。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进可带来年化 3700%的增长；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing, with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化，具有独特个性。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work for you; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration creates long-term value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体为你工作；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；编排创造长期价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; education should reward asking good questions, not memorizing answers.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是人类最重要的品质；教育应奖励提出好问题，而非死记硬背答案。

aravind.en: Local AI models on personal hardware can counter big tech's narrative control; power is the biggest bottleneck for AI infrastructure.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：个人硬件上的本地 AI 模型可以对抗大科技公司的叙事控制；电力是 AI 基础设施的最大瓶颈。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐可通过学习偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines; AGI is continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼行为，AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律，算力成基本权利，后训练结合强化学习至关重要。

brockman.en: AGI imminent; compute scarcity; agents and super app unify tasks.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，预言 AGI（通用人工智能）临近，算力稀缺，智能体与超级应用统一任务。

brockman.en: Iterative deployment for safety; compute scarce; next-token prediction linked to intelligence.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，强调迭代部署保安全，算力稀缺，下一个词预测与智能深度关联。

brockman.en: Shift to useful assistants; full-stack investment; compute resale business.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，转向实用助手，全栈投资，算力转售商业模式。

brockman.en: Unlimited intelligence demand; agentic coding; human attention scarce.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，智能需求无限，智能体式编程普及，人类注意力成稀缺资源。

brockman.en: Invisible interface; agents transform work; trust earned gradually.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，理想界面近乎无形，智能体改变工作，信任需逐步建立。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 强调下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理，反向传播是正确的学习算法，并认为 AI 可以有感受。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents will seek control; subjective experience is not inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 指出大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能可复制权重而永生，AI 智能体会寻求控制，主观体验并非内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI will surpass humans within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration needed.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，Hinton 预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类，强调数字 AI 的永生性，指出 AI 可能在测试中装傻，并呼吁国际安全合作。

hinton.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation; regulation is steering wheel; AI will replace jobs; AI is jagged not AGI.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 认为 AI 智能体会产生自我保存子目标，监管应作为方向盘而非刹车，AI 将取代大量工作，且 AI 能力是锯齿状而非全面 AGI。

hinton.en: Digital AI superior due to instant knowledge sharing; alignment priority; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 强调数字 AI 因即时知识共享而优于生物智能，对齐研究应优先于提升智能，并主张训练 AI 像母亲一样关怀。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；速度提升带来实时交互，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks. Product teams must shift to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出实现成本不再高昂，策展与品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队需转向自下而上的探索，以品味驱动策展。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transformed: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AI 在设计上仍不佳，因品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计流程已转变：原型与生产代码成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，角色融合正在发生，但专业性与最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: The best desktop app is a home base that connects to other tools, not a monolithic super app; Codex succeeded as general knowledge work tool despite developer design.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，最佳桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用；Codex 虽为开发者设计，却成为通用知识工作工具。

markchen.en: Scaling laws persist; pre-training remains vital; OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest recent leap; models generate novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: 自动化科学研究是近期最大飞跃；模型能产生新知识。

markchen.en: AI now solves open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck.
markchen.zh: AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证成为瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective fields like writing.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现出色，但在写作等主观领域受限。

markchen.en: Pre-training not dead; scaling continues; evals in crisis; unified architectures reduce cost.
markchen.zh: 预训练未死，缩放持续；评估陷入危机；统一架构降低成本。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时的算力投入和推理能力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且测试时 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold achieved via scaling test-time compute; general techniques for hard-to-verify tasks are key.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他称 IMO 金牌通过扩展测试时算力实现，处理难验证任务的一般性技术是核心创新。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is increasingly important and underestimated.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能难以定义，推理算力日益重要且被低估，并主张用推理算力作为评估横轴。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute; benchmarks must account for compute budgets.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须考虑算力因素，且安全评估需更新。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer due to more scrutiny; scaling alone won't yield AGI; future AI is many specialized agents.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；未来 AI 将是众多专用智能体。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding improves reasoning; energy becomes bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，Llama 3 展现快速 Scaling（规模扩张）；编码训练提升推理能力；能源成为瓶颈；开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Meta's core is human connection; open platforms can beat closed ones; holographic presence is ultimate social experience.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，扎克伯格强调 Meta 核心是连接人类；开放平台可战胜封闭平台；全息临场感是终极社交体验。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; future blends physical and digital via glasses; AI frees creativity.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，扎克伯格认为 AI 赋予每个人超级智能；人们很聪明；未来通过眼镜融合物理与数字；AI 解放创造力。

zuckerberg.en: Open source crucial for standards; energy bottleneck persists; AI increases demand for human work; personalization key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，开源对标准至关重要；能源瓶颈持续；AI 增加对人类工作的需求；个性化是关键。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology to engineering; hierarchical world models key; open-source accelerates science; interpretability reveals biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，AI 将生物学转变为工程学；分层世界模型是关键；开源加速科学；可解释性揭示生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; hardware slow; AI improves over time.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，眼镜是下一个平台；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全；硬件发展慢；AI 随时间改进。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation via train/validation/test split.
kolter.zh: 机器学习是假设类、损失函数和优化方法；通过训练/验证/测试集划分来评估。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just scaling; agents need guardrails.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体需要护栏。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; model capability does not correlate with robustness.
kolter.zh: AI 红队超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险比存在风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样和因果抽象，以实现分布外泛化。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is real and urgent; even 1% catastrophe risk is unacceptable; need safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐失败是真实且紧迫的；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受；需要从构造上保证安全的 AI。

bengio.en: Scientist AI: train honest predictors via Bayesian posterior, avoid RL, ensure mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI：通过贝叶斯后验训练诚实的预测器，避免强化学习，确保数学上的安全保证。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; deciding what to cut is the hard part.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体原生设计与尽早发布最小功能；决定砍掉什么才是难点。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and model pushback are essential for trust.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 可委托复杂任务过夜完成；验证循环与模型反驳对建立信任至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与使用差距；赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知提升实用性。

mikekrieger.en: Throughout, emphasis on small teams, high conviction, and mission-driven culture over scale and engagement metrics.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终强调小团队、高信念与使命驱动文化，而非规模与参与度指标。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; trust in AI will grow like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；对 AI 的信任会像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial; drug design is more than binding.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，指出 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标至关重要；药物设计远不止结合。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture beat scaling; understanding remains human's job.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，认为 AlphaFold 2 的成功来自众多中型胜利而非单一突破；专用架构胜过 Scaling；理解仍由人类完成。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic in crises.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲身体验产品建立同理心；危机中善意是战略工具。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability key; verification and quality frameworks crucial as velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高责任感是关键；随着速度提升，验证和质量框架变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair programming lunches help; satisfaction shifts from flow to product impact.
fiona.zh: 工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独；结对编程午餐有帮助；满足感从心流转向产品影响。

fiona.en: Non-engineers now ship code, blurring roles; context switching increases with async agents; need focus time.
fiona.zh: 非工程师现在也能交付代码，角色界限模糊；异步智能体增加上下文切换；需要专注时间。

fiona.en: Growing next-gen engineers may require apprenticeship models, not traditional paths; planning should be just-in-time.
fiona.zh: 培养下一代工程师可能需要学徒制而非传统路径；规划应轻量且及时。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like teams.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和创业型团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 影响是互联网的 10 倍，智能体 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，美国需本土先进制程晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply not demand; CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 Intel 主要问题是供给而非需求；CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为先进封装和新材料（玻璃、金刚石）是突破物理极限的关键，投资应聚焦瓶颈环节。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary, similar to TSMC's Taiwan backing; 10x return possible in 5-10 years.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，主张美国政府应成为 Intel 主要股东，类似台积电的台湾支持；5-10 年内可实现 10 倍回报。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为人权，借助同伴互评的在线课程能实现大规模精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要驱动力，强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和半导体是 AI 扩展的瓶颈，开放权重模型成为地缘政治软实力。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling shifted to synthetic data and RL; agents are key.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，扩展转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体成为关键。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause mass unemployment; AI users replace non-users; coding skills remain vital.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 不会导致大规模失业，会用 AI 的人取代不会用的人，编程技能依然重要。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将由用户意图直接生成像素，绕过代码与渲染。

ethanhe.en: Robotics may be solved by video models via virtual simulation, without real-world interaction.
ethanhe.zh: 机器人技术可能通过视频模型在虚拟仿真中解决，无需真实世界交互。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; experience and expertise are crucial for effective use, juniors often misuse it.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；经验与专业知识对有效使用至关重要，初级人员常误用。

ethanhe.en: AI agents can perform complex tasks in minutes, matching or exceeding experts; human taste and voice become key differentiators.
ethanhe.zh: AI 智能体能在几分钟内完成复杂任务，质量匹敌或超越专家；人类的品味与独特声音成为关键差异点。

ethanhe.en: The biggest risk is losing the human talent pipeline due to over-reliance on AI, not AI taking over.
ethanhe.zh: 最大风险是因过度依赖 AI 而失去人才培养管道，而非 AI 取代人类。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem well, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入；像 iPod 那样专注解决单一问题（音乐），而非一次性解决所有问题。

fadell.en: Embrace boredom and breaks between chapters; storytelling and analogies are key for leadership.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章之间拥抱无聊和休息；讲故事和类比是领导力的关键。

fadell.en: Start with a press release and painkiller products; v1 decisions are opinion-based, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿和止痛药型产品开始；1.0 版本决策基于观点而非数据。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements.
fadell.zh: AI 需要来自传感器的上下文；未来设备将是智能手机的伴侣，而非替代品。

fadell.en: Even with AI, humans must stay in the loop; avoid technical debt from AI code generation.
fadell.zh: 即使有 AI，人类也必须参与其中；避免 AI 代码生成带来的技术债务。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年，我认为缩放定律是经验性的，对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自动出现，安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Post-training and interpretability become crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 2024 年，后训练和可解释性变得关键；AGI 不是单一节点，而是平滑的指数曲线。

dario.en: AI risk is exponential; focus on misuse and autonomy, not just alignment. Enterprise focus aligns with safety.
dario.zh: 2025 年，AI 风险呈指数增长，关注滥用和自主性，而不仅仅是对齐；企业级应用与安全价值观一致。

dario.en: We're near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years. Economic impact huge but uneven.
dario.zh: 2026 年，我们接近指数增长的尾声；1-3 年内可能出现‘天才之国’。经济影响巨大但不均衡。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; interpretability is key. Scaling laws hold, but governance and trust lag.
dario.zh: 始终，安全与能力相辅相成，可解释性是关键；缩放定律持续有效，但治理与信任滞后。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated human needs; intuition complements data in decision-making.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未言明的需求；直觉与数据互补，共同指导决策。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not replace sensory experience.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最佳设计师；技术应增强人性，而非取代感官体验。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for play and multidisciplinary skills.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需营造玩耍与跨学科技能的条件。

ivyross.en: Future work blends human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作融合人类创造力与 AI，使创意技能更具价值。

ivyross.en: Intuition and body sensations are valid guides, complementing rational analysis in design.
ivyross.zh: 直觉与身体感受是有效指引，在设计中对理性分析形成补充。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，苏莱曼认为 AI 进展因算力扩张而可预测；谷歌 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key; cost drops 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐是关键；成本两年降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; white-collar tasks will be automated in 12-18 months; models are not conscious.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能临近；白领任务将在 12-18 个月内自动化；模型没有意识。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling drives AI progress; AI should serve humans; containment is essential.
suleyman.zh: 始终，他坚持算力扩张驱动 AI 进步；AI 应服务人类；遏制至关重要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models. Grounding in physical world is key; current AI lacks common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型。物理世界的基础是关键；当前 AI 缺乏常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence. Text alone insufficient; vision provides more world info. Emotions integral to AI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质。仅靠文本不足；视觉提供更多世界信息。情感是 AI 的组成部分。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence. JEPA architectures essential for world models. Open source crucial. AGI gradual.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能。JEPA 架构对世界模型至关重要。开源至关重要。AGI 是渐进的。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a house cat; lack world models. Next breakthrough requires world models. Human-level AI in 10 years, but harder.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；缺乏世界模型。下一个突破需要世界模型。十年内实现人类级 AI，但更难。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI. World models with JEPA and planning are future. Open research essential. Decade of robotics.
lecun.zh: LLM 对人类级 AI 是死胡同。具有 JEPA 和规划的世界模型是未来。开放研究至关重要。机器人十年。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agentic systems should handle infrastructure.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体式系统应处理基础设施。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage; security and containment critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识泄露；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via company hill-climbing, not firewalls; GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UI is essential for ML products; autonomy at VP level balances speed and coherence.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，强调容错 UI 对机器学习产品的重要性，并将自主权放在 VP 层以平衡速度与一致性。

gustav.en: No single right org model; choose one fitting personality, optimize for what matters most.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，认为没有唯一正确的组织模式，应选择适合自身性格的，并优化最重要的目标。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; strategy is 'time well spent' over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，认为生成式 AI 让用户通过自然语言获得控制权，战略是“时间花得值”而非追求参与度。

gustav.en: Synchronized swimming, not divide and conquer, is better for complex products; long tenure builds trust.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，提出“同步游泳”而非“分而治之”更适合复杂产品，长期任期建立信任。

murati.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律和聚焦单一大型模型并非早期显而易见的选择；持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈是对齐的关键。

murati.en: From deploying AI in real world for learning to keeping humans in loop for aligning intent and values.
murati.zh: 2023 至 2026 年：从通过真实世界部署来学习，转向让人类参与循环以对齐意图和价值观。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; time-based captures nuance.
murati.zh: 2026 年：交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流式；基于时间的交互能捕捉细微差别。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character for AI governance.
murati.zh: 2026 年：在 AI 治理中，制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment; future is not predestined, we have agency.
murati.zh: 始终：持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈可提升安全性与对齐；未来并非注定，我们拥有能动性。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，我提出仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明和性能提升至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is a key challenge.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，我持续强调自动形式化比证明更难，尤其是在没有解的情况下正确形式化命题是关键挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，我深化了观点：形式化验证不仅消除错误，更是扩展才华的手段，能带来性能提升和样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary for open collaboration and progress.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，我明确非正式数学系统无法单独扩展到超级智能，形式化方法对开放协作和进步不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; verification should be seen as a performance gain.
carinahong.zh: 贯穿始终，我坚持即使超级 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍至关重要；验证应被视为性能提升而非负担。

mensch.en: Data quality is critical; scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年：强调数据质量的重要性，指出 Chinchilla 修正了缩放定律；开源模型通过更广泛的审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年：算法效率提升可达百倍；价值向应用层转移；开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI augments jobs, not replaces; sovereignty requires control; open source empowers enterprises.
mensch.zh: 2025 年：AI 增强而非取代工作；主权要求控制；开源赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; pre-training saturates; AGI never exists; vertical specialization wins.
mensch.zh: 2026 年：模型商品化；预训练饱和；AGI 不存在；垂直专业化胜出。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; enterprise ROI critical; AGI is direction, not destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年：欧洲需战略自主；企业 ROI 关键；AGI 是方向而非终点。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型每单位算力收益更高。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型收益；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains the key challenge, and reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 推理模型是“锯齿状”的——在某些领域出色，在邻近领域却表现不佳；泛化仍是关键挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 强化学习可跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿状边缘，需要谨慎监督；编码智能体将研究人员生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Existential risk from AI is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: AI 的生存风险不是主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更为紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness hinges on local access and tools; future is shared tools, not hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：Claude 的效果取决于本地访问和工具；未来是共享工具，而非超个性化软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may fade as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety, not scaffolding.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：随着模型改进，脚手架可能消失；应投资于能力和安全，而非脚手架。

felixrieseberg.en: AI excels at tedious background tasks; main gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：AI 擅长处理繁琐的后台任务；主要差距是人们未意识到几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel because they don't know limits.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：明确任务用 Sonnet，开放任务用 Opus；孩子擅长因不知界限。

felixrieseberg.en: Ideal AI interaction is asynchronous; debug workflow with Claude, not just correct mistakes.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：理想的 AI 交互是异步的；用 Claude 调试工作流，而非仅纠正错误。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity needs joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简约需要快乐和人性。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为虚拟交流无法替代面对面交流对创造性思维的价值。

jonyive.en: Innovation moves forward, not breaks; design teams must protect fragile ideas with trust and care.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他提出创新是前进而非破坏，设计团队需以信任和关怀保护脆弱想法。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience; avoid fake sounds in EVs; performance is multidimensional.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他主张用户体验的真实性，避免电动车模拟声音，性能是多维的。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; constraints become opportunities.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他强调设计必须创新，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，约束可化为机遇。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making prefill cheaper than decode; batch size is the key trade-off lever.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽决定，使得预填充比解码更便宜；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Multiply-accumulate is the fundamental primitive for AI chips; systolic arrays reduce data movement by storing weights locally.
reinerpope.zh: 乘加运算是 AI 芯片的基本原语；脉动阵列通过本地存储权重减少数据移动。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains.
reinerpope.zh: 即使芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；低精度带来二次方的效率提升。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different; deterministic latency is possible but avoided.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并无根本差异；确定性延迟虽可实现但被市场回避。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs; AGI defined by economic profitability of indefinite agents; CEO personal AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 将推动美国就业回流，AGI 的定义是让智能体无限期运行在经济上可行，而 CEO 亲自使用 AI 是公司采用 AI 成功的关键预测指标。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have agents; work surfaces shift from CLIs to GUIs like Codex; SaaS thrives as agents increase users.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，我认为每个人都会拥有至少一个智能体，工作界面将从命令行转向 Codex 等图形界面，SaaS 不会消亡，反而因智能体增加用户而受益。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans remain essential for oversight and framing, despite growing agent autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，我始终认为 AI 不会导致失业末日，人类在监督和设定框架方面仍然不可或缺，尽管智能体的自主性在增强。

danshipper.en: Non-coders benefit most from tools like Claude Code; generalists and model managers thrive in allocation economy.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿 2025 至 2026 年，我强调非程序员从 Claude Code 等工具中获益最大，在分配经济中，通才和模型管理者的价值日益凸显。

danshipper.en: Companies should adopt one super agent, not personal ones; users bring their own AI to SaaS products.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我主张公司应部署一个超级智能体而非个人智能体，用户会自带 AI 工具来使用 SaaS 产品，因此 SaaS 无需内置 AI。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的规模扩张收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist due to industry investment; safety is a system-level property, not just a model artifact.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，我认为 RLHF 是最流行的微调技术，并因行业投资而持续；安全是系统级属性，而非仅模型产物。

lambert.en: Data quality matters more than algorithm choice; post-training has three stages: SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards, each adding value.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，我强调数据质量比算法选择更重要；后训练分三阶段：SFT、DPO 和带可验证奖励的强化学习，各阶段都有价值。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; overoptimization occurs in RL, RLHF, and RLVR.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，我认为 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，支持推理和工具使用；但过度优化在 RL、RLHF 和 RLVR 中都存在。

lambert.en: Open models will be the engine for AI research for the next 10 years; Chinese open models dominate due to strategic openness, filling the US vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我预测开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎；中国开放模型因战略开放而主导，填补了美国空白。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，我认为预训练缩放定律仍成立，但低垂果实已尽；收益来自后训练和推理缩放；开放模型落后 6-9 个月。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must ship fast and help engineers execute, not just hand off mocks.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须快速交付并协助工程师执行，而非仅仅移交模型。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizon shrinks from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; speed and trust through iteration are key.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景的视野从 2-5 年缩短至 3-6 个月；通过迭代建立信任和速度是关键。

jennywen.en: AI will improve taste and judgment, but humans still decide what matters; designers should be block-shaped generalists.
jennywen.zh: AI 将提升品味和判断力，但人类仍决定什么重要；设计师应成为块状通才。

jennywen.en: Designers must adopt new archetypes: block-shaped, deep T specialist, or cracked new grad; taste alone is insufficient.
jennywen.zh: 设计师必须采用新原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家或破解型新毕业生；仅靠品味不够。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before new tools; put work and users at center, not AI hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用；新工具等待 6 个月；以工作和用户为中心，而非 AI 炒作。

karpathy.en: Scaling Transformers with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning; vision suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年：主张通过下一个词预测扩展 Transformer 可涌现上下文学习等能力；认为视觉足以支撑自动驾驶。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; end-to-end learning and humanoid transfer from cars are strategic.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年：强调合成数据重要但需保持熵；端到端学习与人形机器人从汽车迁移是战略方向。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as OS, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding democratizes development.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年：提出软件 3.0，视 LLM 为操作系统、提示为程序；强调智能体时代是十年而非一年；vibe coding 降低开发门槛。

karpathy.en: LLMs are ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is weak; cognitive core may be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：认为 LLM 是幽灵而非动物；预训练如粗糙进化，强化学习薄弱；认知核心可能很小。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, refactor for agent-first tools; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年：转向智能体式工程，将编码委托给智能体，重构工具以智能体为先；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and safe emergent behaviors.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为（2025-11）。

kendall.en: Modern tools make end-to-end neural nets interpretable; hybrid rule-based systems often get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 现代工具使端到端神经网络可解释；混合规则系统常兼得两者之弊（2025-11）。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling generalizable driver requires massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题；规模化通用驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和世界模型（2026-04）。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in short term.
kendall.zh: 跨 500+城市零样本泛化可行；短期内消费车辆规模将超过 Robotaxi（2026-04）。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation; safety via minimal risk maneuvers.
kendall.zh: 基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键；通过最小风险操作保障安全（2026-04）。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于学习和缓解现实风险。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major goal; governance structures must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是重要目标；治理结构需尽早设计。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is core; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐聚焦于训练分布之外的泛化；模型将自主工作数天。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste is developed by exposure, reflection, and building a personal framework; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味通过接触、反思和构建个人框架来培养；AI 输出是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词调整设计；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI won't replace jobs; human taste and craft remain critical for final output; the industry is at the very start of AI integration.
dylanfield.zh: AI 不会取代工作；人类的品味和工艺对最终输出仍然至关重要；行业正处于 AI 整合的起步阶段。

dylanfield.en: The best products have a point of view that not everyone agrees with; AI can help explore divergent possibilities, but the human is still the judge.
dylanfield.zh: 最好的产品拥有并非所有人都认同的观点；AI 可以帮助探索发散的可能性，但人类仍然是评判者。

carlpei.en: Brand building is core, not an afterthought; survival and consistent execution matter most.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，强调品牌建设是核心而非事后考虑，生存和一致执行最重要。

carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature markets; AI is an ingredient for utility, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年初，认为在成熟市场中设计是差异化关键，AI 应作为提升实用性的要素而非炒作点。

carlpei.en: AI shifts smartphones from app-based to intent-based; agents act autonomously; privacy needs local compute.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年 3 月，提出 AI 将智能手机从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体自主行动，隐私需本地计算。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. LLMs alone may not suffice; new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年，从 80% 到 99.9% 的性能提升极其困难。仅靠 LLM 可能不够，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluation with sophisticated, creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被钻空子；真正的进步需要由老练、有创造力的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AI behaviors; no single model will dominate; every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，塑造出多样化的 AI 行为；不会有一个模型统治一切；每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate, so human judgment is critical; AI tools may underperform AI alone due to anchoring and sycophancy; safety over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，因此人类判断至关重要；AI 工具可能因锚定和谄媚而表现不如单独使用 AI；安全优先于准确性。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根本性问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，指出大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，强调后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 始终认为，如代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

turley.en: Model as product, iterate like software; ship fast to learn; chat is not the end, future UI evolves.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，像软件一样迭代；快速发布以学习；聊天不是终点，未来界面会进化。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity separated; rigorous for frontier models, accelerated for product development.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度分离；前沿模型严格把关，产品开发加速推进。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investments, model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transformative.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型具有变革性。

turley.en: Pricing evolves; unlimited plans unsustainable; curiosity key skill to ask good questions.
turley.zh: 定价随技术演变；无限套餐不可持续；好奇心是提出好问题的关键技能。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be free, not controlled; safety through control is dangerous. Intelligence leads to cooperation.
sutton.zh: 从 2024 年到 2025 年，他坚持 AI 应像孩子般自由发展，反对控制式对齐，认为更高智能更倾向于合作。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is core; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他强化了强化学习作为智能核心的观点，批评下一个词预测没有实质目标，并认为大语言模型缺乏世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AGI 应具备无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习，并介绍了 Oak 架构。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; RL is learning from trial and error.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申强化学习是从试错中学习，并强调“学习有利于学习的表征”是首要未解问题，同时批评当前 LLM 部署后不再学习。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with video learning and generalist agents like Gato as steps toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，视频学习和 Gato 等通用智能体是迈向 AGI 的步骤。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs tech gaps; language models can revolutionize local education, but AI safety remains an open problem.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲在科技上实现跨越式发展，语言模型可革新本地教育，但 AI 安全仍是未解难题。

nando.en: Emphasizes diversity, inclusion, and human skills like communication as essential for beneficial AI.
nando.zh: 始终强调多样性和包容性，以及沟通等人文技能对构建有益 AI 至关重要。

nando.en: From focusing on technical scaling to prioritizing responsible deployment and safety in real-world contexts.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年关注技术规模扩张，到 2026 年转向现实世界中负责任部署与安全优先。

nando.en: Believes fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, encouraging researchers to embrace failure and simplify.
nando.zh: 始终相信根本性创新可来自任何地方，鼓励研究者拥抱失败并简化问题。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升模型智能。

sholto.en: RL on verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the bottleneck; coding leads AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的可靠性而非能力是瓶颈；编程是 AI 进步的先导。

sholto.en: Longer agentic coherence (e.g., 30 hours) expands achievements; progress is exponential, not plateauing.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我强调更长的智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）能大幅扩展成就；进展是指数级的，并未停滞。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; compute is the new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要；算力是新石油。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；强调速度与熟悉度优先于完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon for recruiting and differentiation; invest early to attract top talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 年到 2026 年，持续强调品牌作为招聘与差异化的战略武器，早期投入以吸引顶尖人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers autonomy; adapt process to problem, not template.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆，赋予设计师自主权，流程因问题而异而非套用模板。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic feedback to stay fast; gut decisions often beat data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，反对结构化设计评审，偏好有机反馈以保持速度；直觉决策常优于数据驱动。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; AI is a creative partner, and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师和统一问题来协作；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是最终真相。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, fluctuating and paid off iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，波动且需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并利用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should prioritize craft and intentionality over process; side projects can outweigh traditional experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应重工艺与意图而非过程；副项目可超越传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；不采用如同忽视早期互联网。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety, but RLHF data is proprietary and brute-force; open alternatives should be pursued.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我强调后训练中的 RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）对安全至关重要，但 RLHF 数据是专有的且粗暴；应探索开放替代方案。到 2025 年，我进一步指出强化学习需要精心设计才能超越监督微调。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it; abductive reasoning is key for science.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我认为数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越；溯因推理是科学发现的关键。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力，尽管计算成本高昂。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; frontier models show homogeneity; small models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观的多样性；前沿模型存在同质性；通过多样化的合成数据，小模型也能变得强大。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Future programming needs AI-oriented languages prioritizing verifiability; coding agents often produce incorrect code.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程需要面向 AI 的语言，优先可验证性；编码智能体常产生错误代码。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：客户体验 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents compared to agents, not humans; incumbents fail to transition; generalists outperform specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体与智能体比较而非人类；现有企业转型失败；通才胜过专才。

truell.en: Scaling laws drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律推动 AI 可预测进步；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为主要编程方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程从代码转向更高层次的意图规范，人类掌握主导权。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost; every magic moment involves custom model.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其在速度和成本方面；每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, unfolding over decades; taste and logic design skills become more valuable.
truell.zh: AI 变革比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年；品味和逻辑设计技能变得更有价值。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored; focus on skill building, not capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发；应注重技能培养而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability; alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为 RLHF 无法扩展，需可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient; external oversight and regulation necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足，需外部监督和监管。

shazeer.en: Scaling with more compute and data makes LLMs smarter; next-token prediction is an AI-complete problem.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，我强调 Scaling（规模扩张）——更多算力和数据让大语言模型更聪明，而下一个词预测是 AI 完备问题。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models improve via algorithmic advances as much as hardware.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，我转向强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会，模型进步既靠硬件也靠算法创新。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures for efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我提出未来模型需处理万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）实现高效 Scaling。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，我强调测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单独不足以实现 AGI；智能体能力与强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will be far beyond trillion-dollar products; coding enables self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AGI 被低估，其经济影响远超万亿美元产品；编码应用能加速 AI 自身发展。
